  "memo":"R03 holds: the FR-issued card was used from a US IP, and AVS and CVV failed. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Under FP-2 §6.6(b), recommend needs_check with id_check; no check has completed. The longstanding card and device support a legitimate-customer explanation but do not establish authorization. The order has already shipped, so verification cannot pause fulfilment or prevent its shipment loss. Clear is not yet permitted, and a single adverse family does not permit decline before a deciding check outcome. This recommendation is advisory and sets no queue priority."
